summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X S&P Catholic Values Developed ex-US ETF (CEFA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of large-cap stocks from Developed ex-US markets. The cap-weighted index screens out firms inconsistent with Catholic values. CEFA was launched on Jun 22, 2020 and is issued by Global X.
infoTable: S&P Developed Ex-U.S. Catholic Values Index

holdings.infoBox: CEFA is an equity ETF with a total of 339 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 3.67%, HSBC Holdings at 1.85%, Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 1.74%, CSL Limited at 1.66%, and argenx SE at 1.62%.
